title: Rathoris
summary: Raleigh names Rathoris in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Rathoris or Athoris, brother of Queene Thermutis. The table prints An. Mundi 2488. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 2488. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 2488 = 1545 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.
